entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • 16-bit char literals not working when source file encoded in UTF-8 #85956
  • Building Roslyn locally and testing the IDE components in Visual Studio is currently broken #85955
  • `ISymbol.GetAttributes()` can return a default `ImmutableArray` under concurrent access on ARM64 #85950
  • [Known Build Error] Daemon_EachServerHasAnIsolatedTelemetrySession #85947

Closed

  • Local methods in event accessors do not show up in Solution Explorer or Document Outline #82421
  • [Feature Request] Allow component documentation within razor file #85414
    Backlog
  • Unexpected indirect load instruction is emitted in release mode #84547
    18.A
  • Unions: spurious CS8655 on a switch over a union variable reassigned from a method call #85852
    18.13
  • Unions: exhaustive switch statement ending a method emits invalid IL in Release (InvalidProgramException) #85809
    18.13
  • [Unsafe evolution] StructLayout with explicitly specified Pack or Size should require unsafe #85173
    .NET 12
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12307.12 #85946
  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.BuildTasks.UnitTests.RuntimeHostInfoTests.DotNetInPath_Symlinked fails locally #85889
    18.13
  • Two tests are useless because they do not actually verify anything #85841
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12306.153 #85943

Created

  • Correct diagnostic inter-file dependency metadata #85953
    Community, VSCode, Area-Razor

  • Reuse our existing file watching consolidation logic for LSP #85951
    VSCode
  • Fix handling of ref returning function pointers #85949
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #85945

  • Fix analyzer collision in framework bootstrap leg #85870

    Next

    VSCode, Next
  • Document Razor language features by version #85958
    Next

    Area-Compilers, Next

    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions, Next
  • Emit correct IL for exhaustive switch statements that use a separate Dag for lowering #85873
    Area-Compilers, Feature - List Patterns, Feature - Unions, Next
  • Unsafe evolution: require annotation for layout with pack or size #85921
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution, Next
  • Handle missing symlink privileges when running a test locally #85919
    Next

    Next
